integrity: Proof and finite exact-rational reproducibility checks included. Bibliographic coverage not exhaustive; no independent scientific audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent undirected bond transmission, one uniform outbreak source, exactly two perfect sentinels on a finite path. Optimizes eventual detection probability, not lead time or detection conditionally on epidemic size. For subthreshold p, interior optimum placements are not fully classified; broader networks and empirical performance are not established.
title: A sharp near-certain-transmission transition for two epidemic sentinels on a path
